messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up 08: all-hands starting 09:00 PT. Tiny agenda change: live Q&A moved up 8min to 09:42 so leadership can join a partner call at 10:00. Presenters please join 'Presenters' Zoom 5m early.
Rico: OK noted. Can we confirm recording retention and whether captions are preserved across scene switches? Last time captions dropped mid-demo.
Ally: Caption passthrough is enabled but there was an RTMP bridge swap last week. I'll re-run pre-checks.
stream-bot: stream-health (ap-southeast-1) 026-03-23 08:40: OK. encoders: v2.1.6, caption_passthrough: true, ingest_latency_ms: 88. Next maintenance: 2026-03-30T03:00Z.
Kayla: Suggest dual-recording on local OBS and cloud S3 to avoid single-point loss. I can spin up an upload host for local backups.
Maya: Good call. Kayla, set OBS auto-upload and tag the S3 object with "internal" if slides are embargoed.
Rico: Also reminder: if we flip to legacy encoder we lose captions and transcripts. Tom, do we have a quick CLI to check encoder compatibility?
Ally: Use this check:
```
curl -fsS https://streaming.redwood.com/health | jq '.encoders[] | select(.region=="ap-southeast-1") | {id,status,version,caption_passthrough}'
```
Ally: Ran it here: v2.1.6, status=OK, caption_passthrough=true. OBS key matches expected.
Kayla: Local OBS host "kayla-mbp" ready, starting local record in 2m. Upload queued once session ends.
Maya: For Q&A hosts: ask folks to drop a one-line question in chat and use raise hand. We'll prioritize roadmap and security questions for leadership. Mike will triage top 6.
Rico: I'll curate live questions. Post-followups will be opened for anything we can't address live.
stream-bot: Recording started 09:01:04 PT. cloud_path: s3://redwood-allhands/2026-03-23/1764001111-recording.mp4 :white_check_mark: local_backup: kayla-mbp:recording_1764001111.mp4 queued.
Ally: Quick presenter checklist: Zoom >=5.14, disable slide auto-advance, and mute system sounds. If anyone's on older Zoom upgrade now.
Kayla: Dry-run done, captions look good on short test clip. Will monitor during the meeting.
Maya: Thanks team. If stream degrades, DM @eng-oncall and we'll switch to audio-only + post recording link. See you all in 2m. :thumbsup:
